content: The information provided here is not intended to serve as individual medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Minoxidil, commonly sold under brand names such as Rogaine, is available in solution and foam forms. It is used to promote hair growth in men experiencing male pattern baldness. However, it is not effective for hair loss at the front of the scalp or receding hairlines. Minoxidil belongs to a class of drugs known as vasodilators, although the exact mechanism by which it stimulates hair growth is not fully understood. Instructions for Use: Before using this product, carefully read and follow all instructions on the packaging. It can also be applied to damp hair. For the solution: Part your hair in the thinning area and apply the solution evenly to the affected scalp area. Gently rub it in. For the foam: Rinse your hands with cold water and dry them thoroughly. Apply about half a capful of foam to the scalp and gently rub it in. Do not apply this product to other parts of the body unless directed by your doctor. Avoid using it on skin that is red, painful, irritated, scraped, cut, or infected. Wash your hands thoroughly after application and avoid contact with your eyes. Do not use this medication more frequently, in larger amounts, or on irritated or sunburned scalps, as this may lead to excessive absorption into the body and result in serious side effects. This product may contain alcohol, which can cause irritation or dryness of the scalp. Hair regrowth takes time, and most individuals need to use this medication consistently for at least four months to see results. Continuous use is required to maintain hair growth. Potential Side Effects: Common side effects include burning, stinging, or redness at the application site. If your doctor has recommended this medication, they have determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Rarely, minoxidil can be absorbed through the skin and cause systemic side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. If you experience any concerning symptoms, contact your doctor for medical advice. Precautions: Before using minoxidil, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this product should only be used if clearly needed. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call emergency services immediately (911 in the U.S.). Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, skip it and apply the next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this product at room temperature, away from heat. It is flammable, so keep it away from fire and avoid open flames after application until the medication has dried completely. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
